name: Workload profile: Compute heavy
description: Precomputed compound score for compute-heavy (HPC/number-crunching) workloads. A weighted average of normalised scores, each normalised to [0, 1] across all servers in the dataset. Component weights: 35% PassMark CPU Mark (composite), 25% stress-ng div16 single core, 20% Geekbench score (multi-core), 20% memory read bandwidth (64 MB, sc-membench).
